content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing some performance challenges with the current [product_name] and have questions about the next version. In our standard application, we need to use another brand instead of [product_name] mainly due to: * Lack of programmable backlight (having it always on would be helpful). * Insufficient text blocks (increasing to 20 would improve functionality). I hope one day we can use [product_name] for this application. Another feature that would be appreciated is an analog output module. Is there a [url] where we can track progress or updates for the upcoming [product_name] version? Regards, [user_name]

Hello, Allowing the backlight to stay on permanently is not straightforward due to potential overheating in the [product_name] basic module. Regarding messaging functionality, you may already know that you can combine text and values/parameters in one line, so each message can contain up to 4 values. With this, 10 message blocks are quite a lot for most use cases. As for your last point about analog output modules, if possible, attend the SPS/IPC/DRIVES fair in Nuremberg at the end of November; you'll see something very interesting there! Regards, [user_name]

Hi, Your previous answer felt a bit evasive. I would also appreciate an option to control the backlight. I understand the temperature issue with having it always on, but being able to switch it on through the software for a set period, like when pressing a front panel button, would be a useful feature—what's the difference in heat build-up for that scenario? Regarding the message limitations, I've used the analog multiplexer to display various numbers within a text, increasing the amount of possible messages. Kind regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are dissatisfied with some usability and functional restrictions in [product_name], specifically the limited control over display backlight, the number of text/message blocks, and lack of an analog output module. They seek more flexibility in hardware and software features, frequent updates, and a way to stay informed about product development. Technical constraints are acknowledged, but users still hope for improvements through future upgrades.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a programmable or always-on backlight, higher capacity for text/message blocks, and analog output modules. Staying informed about product development and future enhancements is also important to them.
